provenance: Project author's confirmation after reviewing the existing assessments.
scope: The existing semantic review: 241 responses (225 main and 16 robustness). The author reviewed and accepted all of these assessments.
item_level_entry_method: Existing source decisions copied unchanged following the author's explicit acceptance of the complete set.
limits: This records the author's confirmation of existing assessments, not a second independently elicited annotation set.
Approval applies to these 241 semantic-review decisions, not to all 439 form items or all 1950 experimental responses.
Ten UNRESOLVED decisions remain unresolved; accepting that status does not resolve their factual ambiguity.
No new independent accuracy, macro F1 or kappa is inferred from accepting pre-existing assessments.
statement_en: The assessments have been reviewed and approved by a human.
